messages.workspaceNotAvailable: That Preset workspace does not exist or is not authorized for the connected identity. Call list_workspaces and use an id it returns; this will not resolve on its own.
messages.capabilityRequired: This workspace operation was not run: the connected token lacks the required Superset capability. Ask your administrator to configure the intended scope grant, then reauthorize the client with that scope. Workspace RBAC still applies.
messages.unreviewedTool: No reviewed Preset workspace tool has this name, so the call was not run.
messages.wrapperHint: The Preset workspace rejected the arguments for '{tool}' and did not run it. The workspace did not report which field failed. These arguments have no top-level `request` key: most Preset workspace tools take one, so resend the same fields as {"request": {...}} if this tool's inputSchema declares it.
messages.workspaceIdNotNumeric: workspace_id must be the numeric workspace ID
